question: Does Ramapo have a Black Student Union or other cultural orgs? how do i join one

body.answer:
Yes. Ramapo lists the Black Student Union (BSU), category “Student Organization,” with “Lifetime membership”; its page is https://archway.ramapo.edu/BSU/ [1]. Other culturally based organizations listed are Students of Caribbean Ancestry (SOCA), Greek Culture Club, Association of Latinos Moving Ahead (ALMA), Organization of Latino Unity (OLU), South Asian Club, Filipino American Student Association (FASA), Balkan Student Association, United Asian Association (UAA), and African Federation of Representation and Opportunity (AFRO) [2]. Black American Music Club (BAM) also explores music rooted in Black American culture [5]. Culture Club is marked not currently active as of 6/12/25 [6].

The Multicultural Center and Office of Access, Belonging and Community (ABC) lists culturally based organizations and their upcoming programs. Contact ABC at abc@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7720, room D-214 [2].

The Center for Student Involvement says all clubs listed on its page are open to all students [4]. Explore clubs on Archway at https://archway.ramapo.edu or use the Archway app [10]. To get involved with BSU, email bsu@ramapo.edu [3]. ALMA says everyone is welcome; email alma08@ramapo.edu [7]. South Asian Club lists southasians@ramapo.edu [8]. BAM lists bam@ramapo.edu [5]. Center for Student Involvement: csi@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7593, room SC-202 [3].
